name: The Paracelsian Project
source:
In an unfamiliar location with unfamiliar people. You are Elina and you're... That's a good question, who are you? Were you drugged? It's up to you to figure out how you got here and why, and the massive implications for the future... and the past.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066380/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
到了陌生的地方，遇到了陌生的人。你是艾琳娜，你是……这是个好问题，你是谁？你被下药了吗？由你来弄清楚你是如何到达这里的以及为什么，以及对未来……和过去的巨大影响。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066380/]Steam[/url]]
